reviews.text: Ticked off😡😤. Not thrilled. I have canceled this app like a million times now. Yet they keep trying to take money from my account and causing me charges. Tomorrow it’s closed! I have had it!!
It keep freezing. Trash the keep freezing every time

Helpful. I tried this app for a week I’ve been severely underweight for years and a week in and I’m already making insane progress in reaching my goals the app does all the hard work and I just eat whatever I want

Do not sign up.. I signed up and immediately started getting charged multiple times. I tried to cancel and they can’t find my account even though I provided an account # 
. Additionally can’t find it either my email yet still collecting money. Now they are ignoring my emails. Horrible APP. Buyer beware. Reporting to my Bank and APPLE as a fraud!!!!

Update another $19.99 deducted!!!!! Ridiculous
wont let me cancel. I tried for 3 days during free trial - they keep asking me my email address on my email!!! worst app ever

Helping. I like the app because it allows me to make sure that what I’m eating is in my diet and making sure that I’m not overindulging in my calories which I sometimes do because I hate being wasteful with food, but I’m on some most of the days I try to stay under it or way under it just in case, but yeah, Lean is a good app and I recommend
Winning.. This app is very helpful and opens your eyes to habits you didn’t even know you had. Then it’s on you to find new solutions to fit your macros.
rip off scam. App doesn’t even stay open! Took my money though.

BEWARE- scam subscription. Starts with a $6.98 purchase but turned into a $30.52 monthly subscription that’s never showed up in my iPhone subscription section. Unfortunately I didn’t notice the payments until 4 months later. Then they Refused to refund. Very misleading, if you have to trick people into subscription payments the product isn’t worth it.
Multiple Unauthorized charges. I dowloaded hoping that it will help me with my weight loss journey, but after signing up, I was hit with multiple charges that I did not unauthorized!
Won’t open😢. The app worked great day one. Day two I can’t get it to open at all. Very disappointing as I was using it then is just blanked out and now it won’t open at all
Great. It’s been incredible for me so far , it was quite difficult counting calories , but this app has changed all that

Great little helper. Since using this app to help me track my calories, I have lost 28lbs. (48 days). Disclosure this isn’t the only thing I’ve done to use that weight. If you use this along with sound meal preparation and steady workouts, you can lose weight too. Great tool for sure!! Highly recommend!
Rip Off. I canceled my subscription but they keep tryin to charge my card! What a scam!

Waste of money, don’t buy. It’s very “rough” when calculating food. If you’re ACTUALLY tracking your macros and calories seriously this is not the way to do it. (It’s way easier to just ask chat gpt “how many calories in ‘x’ food”)

Also the ’bmi tracker’ is the most pointless thing in the app. Without any data it just slaps a random BMI number on your account.

The people who made this are also scummy. They intentionally don’t provide an option for you to cancel on the app. Also not allowing you to do a free-trial if you want to pay annually. I effectively wasted $40 on this.
Terrible. This is a scam. The app signs you out and the you are unable to sign back in without them asking for a new subscription.
Love this app. Really enjoying Lean. It’s allowing me to keep track of my calories by scanning the foods and reminding me of fasting times.
No incentive. I feel no support no support
The owners of this app are crooks!!. This app is a ripoff! They will steal your money without your permission. Don’t fall for the “trial”. It’s a lie!!!!
Scam. You buy the app then they try to demand more and more money once you install the app. It worked fine for 2 days then received a bill for another 36.00. Complete rip off
Great option. Helps me keep up with my daily intake when I’m on the go. I think the food scanner could use a little work but overall a solid product.

bait and switch. Agreed to $6.93 for 3 month trial then subscription would be charged . I got email almost immediately they were going to charge me the subscription rate in 7 days. I don't like dishonesty. I emailed immediately to say they were not truthful and I wanted the $6.93 back. It's not the money it's the principle. Ashley from support said no refund even after I explained what the company did. Not cool at all. How many others paid money for nothing?
Food calculators. Awesome and accurate
Use everyday. Its a good app just bugs sometimes an wont let me on it

App Does Not Work. App flat out does not work. I’d like my subscription back. All I get is a screen that says welcome to Lean and a button that doesn’t function. Takes you nowhere. I was able to use the app for a day and now I feel scammed. I’ve tried to reach out to the Lean “contact us” and the button to submit doesn’t even work. This all seems very sketchy.

Money Grab company.. Money grab company. Downloaded it got the free trial. Forgot about it after they charged my account. Never used the app never logged any food or workouts nothing. Simply canceled subscription and asked for a refund cause I won’t be using the app. They said no. I guess a free $40 for another money grab health/fitness app.

Poor Customer Service. I had an issue with billing and was charged an unexpected fee. When I contacted them about it I was basically referred to their ’no refund policy’. When I asked for more details and a confirmation that there would be no additional charges they basically ghosted me. I sent two separate correspondences, both of which were ignored. I find this extremely unprofessional. Buyer beware!
Subscription. Deleted after seeing it’s just another app that wants you to pay.
Works great with progress to back it up. App has been great, lost 111 lbs within 6 months with the help from this app

Fraudulent charges. I don’t even have an account and I got charged ! I only got a paid trial for 5 days and they are charging me non stop ! I don’t have an account and there’s no way to reach these people

Avoid this TERRIBLE app. There is no way to change a serving size when you scan your food. So even when you eat half of a recommended serving, it records the entire serving on the log. There are much better apps out there. Even though I was suppose to get three free days they charged for a year.

Zero stars. This app is extremely disappointing. None of the features that were advertised are actually available. The interface is confusing, poorly designed, and there is no clear way to cancel the subscription anywhere in the app, which feels intentional.
Charging users for something that does not deliver what was promised is misleading and unacceptable. This feels like a scam rather than a legitimate service.
I do not recommend this app at all. Save your money and your time. I will be warning others so they don’t fall into the same situation.
No functioning or support. Terrible app, once you start actually trying to progress your tracking it won’t work. Non of your numbers change.

It’s good. Food scanning is accurate. It works well. I suspect issues others have reported with food scanning has to do with backgrounds being too complicated. If you put your food on an uncomplicated background scans are quite accurate.
Good Assistance. Great at helping keep track of my consumption

Accuracy is questionable. Whenever I try putting twice as much of something in a bowl, to test the quantitation, the macros do not scale Properly at all. All the reported values of scanned food are probably inaccurate,potentially by a lot. The barcode scanning doesn't recognize a lot of products. Macros for Any meal with multiple ingredients can't be accurately quantified unless you do it along the way ingredient by ingredient, defeating the app's entire purpose.
Great app. Year is definitely the way to go

App doesn’t work. I downloaded the app and started using it. When I went back to update info the app would just close out. I shut my phone off and back on, still didn’t work. I deleted the app and started all over again and it just kicks me out of the app and keeps wanting me to start over. I subscribed for one year and I am out that money.
App costumer service not helpful. It’s been 21 days since I reported issues with the app, and no response. I do not recommend this app.
Best apps. It helps you check calories and everything

Not worth the money. Try before you buy - the food database is worthless. Not intuitive at all. Enter a simple food and get all sort of suggestions that have nothing to
do with what you entered. Very frustrating and basically makes the app worthless.

Yet another app claiming to be free. Says it’s free and like SO many “free” apps on the apple App Store it lied. I have not found a single free app on this horrid platform I can not wait to go back to my Samsung.

Hoping it gets better. The database of food is extremely limited. I have yet to scan a barcode that actually pulls up info. You end up having to manually input most everything. The carbs, fat and protein counters won’t let you put in a decimal so you can’t log .5 for example. Paid $40 and still have 50 weeks left. Maybe a big update will make this worth it.
Ryan’s review. Love the app

Buns app. the app literally does nothing besides show the goal calories etc unless you pay. i can’t log food in manually its pay or get out and it was advertised as completely free dont download unless you wanna pay 40$ a year for a special calculator

You lost me when you didn’t know what bresaola is. Could have been a great app that I was willing to pay for. But it doesn’t know a lot of common dishes and foods that I’m unable to log in. So what’s the point?
Narrow scope. Please include low carb diet options! I thought this was a carb counting app! It looks great so far, but not what I need right now
Useless unless you throw money at it. Garbage

Has potential, but not there yet. Only is able to recognize food half of the time. Very frustrating. I regret purchasing the year subscription. Do not purchase this until more updates are made towards the software. Maybe in a year or two it will be better
Great. I’ve been using it for about a week and I can notice the difference and how I eat and how I feel Great to keep myself accountable
Different approach. This fasting app will AI driven food scanner is working for me.
Excelente. Very good!! Love. It
Boo. Apple never has free from subscription apps

Works well but needs improvement and terrible customer service. Purchased app and used it for 2 days before it stopped working. You cannot update any initial data to update calorie goals (ie when you become more/less active), when I tried to do this, it disconnected my paid subscription and I cannot get back in. No help from customer service to use this app again.
waste of money. terrible app. nothing loads. can’t find simple foods. i should’ve done more research before paying for it. canceling my subscription.
Needs to scan food better. Can’t register food
Scam. App does not work. You cannot change settings and you will not hear from anyone. Disputed my charges.
Pleased. I love this app! Easy to keep up with my daily calorie intake!
Don’t get it. The work out logging doesn’t work all the time and the picture scanning of food never works .
Canceled subscription. App was very helpful and I say to use but I have canceled my weekly subscription and yet they are still withdrawing money from my account.

Could be better. The concept is cool, but if you eat out the database doesn’t pull food suggestions from restaurants. Which would cause you to miss a meal or know the exact products the restaurant used to make your food.

OK but could be better. I’ve used the app for a couple months. It’s ok but has some shortcomings that may make me move on. I’ve used several of these apps and two main issues I have are (1) the ability input a portion of a food and (2) a few clunky food search process. On (1), all other apps I have used allowed you to input .25, .50, etc if I only ate a quarter or half of a portion of a food. On (2), if I type in Chik-Fil- A chicken sandwich, that should the first thing that shows up. Instead I get a random list of all sorts of chicken products and with the description cut off on the screen I have to click into the item to see if jar I am looking for. The food search really is terrible given search capabilities that exist in tech space.
Please don’t waste your money. This app is the glitchiest anti-user app I’ve ever used. Go use any of the countless other apps that function the same and don’t glitch and are somewhat user friendly.

Lacking. After using the free trial for a couple days, it just seems that the app lacks a lot of information in regards to nutrition and where it’s getting its info from, the camera also sometimes has trouble focusing, cool concept though

Stolen money for no product. They are unresponsive and won’t fix an issue on their end causing me to have to repeatedly buy this product to attempt to use it. I even showed my receipt of purchase but they’ve ghosted me.




They took the time to email me the same canned response they added under my review and nothing has been done. No fix of the membership or refund.

This app is a SCAM
Doesn’t work. Doesn’t work. I paid for the use and won’t even work, keeps asking me to pay again even though I have a subscription. Emailed them and they didn’t help
Scam. It’s a complete scam doesn’t work and took my $40

Needs work, Please Fix.. I bought the subscription, filled everything out to the T and it inputted my height wrong twice. First time was 8’7” (I’m 5’7”) Second time was 7970’. Will not be using the app unless it is fixed. It doesn’t help that’s there’s no way to edit your personal measurements in your profile.

Food lookup useless.. WW is way better. I should have read more reviews before buying. Scanning barcodes seems to work well, but looking up even simple foods shows zero quantity info. So I have to Google nutritional info, create my own and manually enter, including putting serving size in title. (So I hope others can find when the search.) unsure of scanning a plate, but given the issues with how they figure quantity, not sure I have any confidence in that.
Not user friendly. This is not a user friendly app at all. I would like my money back please.
Good but not great. The app is easy to use but I hate that I can’t put in decimal numbers (ex. 1/2 tbsp). It only allows for whole numbers. Kind of unfortunate.

No support. I purchased a year subscription and never received any of the benefits or ability to use the app. The app keeps redirecting me to the subscribe page. I messaged support to get some help or recourse and never got any response. Definitely would not recommend. Just a waste of money.

Not working. Subscribed to the yearly plan and when I want to log exercise or food, it asks me to subscribe again. So I click subscribe and it tells me that I have already subscribed. Please refund me as I am not able to use your app!!!!

Disappointing.. I just purchased this for a whole year and it continues to ask me to pay for the trial :( 

I’m unable to log in any info…

Useless. This app is absolutely useless. I paid the $40 for the membership, and I can’t enter any workouts or calories. If I tried to enter anything, it tells me I need to “get full access” and wants me to pay another $40 yearly membership. Even though I already did. The only thing that app is doing for me right now is showing me my weight. I don’t need to pay $40 a year to see my weight. I get that for free every morning, when I step on that scale.

Don’t waste your money. I have to take multiple pictures of my food for it to actually calculate. A lot of times it never calculates so I just have to manually enter myself anyways. Not worth the money. I have emailed twice and never got a response. Doesn’t offer any recipe ideas and doesn’t let you edit your goals or current height or weight
Paid for nothing?. I paid for the 1 year subscription and I still can’t upload any pictures and it’s asking me to pay again instead?????
Impossible. Says my daily calorie intake should be 144. I would die.

Not letting me fix mistake on my personal info. This app seems great. I didn’t realize I had made a mistake when I input my height and it could be skewing my daily numbers. There is no way to edit your personal info which is weird.

Good but…. I love how the app works, but the biggest bummer is not being able to add half portions to serving sizes. If I could change the portion size to 1.5 or something like that, I’d give it 5 stars.

Free to download but that’s it. The app itself looks good but you can not do anything as in log anything unless you buy the subscription so it’s just easier to google mirco counter online and use that instead of eating your money also the Marco’s that it show that are “based on you” are not the best or ideal macros but just an generalization for the population so would not recommend
LEAN. This is a horrible app

Trying to submit support for refund, “submit” button not live. This app does not sync or connect to Apple Health which is what I searched when I found it. Because it does not do this, it is of no use to me and I would like the $39.99 back.
Dime a dozen. Apps not that great. Doesn’t do a great job tracking the things you eat with the correct amount of protein/calories. On to the next
Average intelligence at best. Search results are often off the mark.

Not worth the $$. The search database is lacking. I can’t seem to figure out how to delete a workout that is incorrect. I would rather use a pencil and paper at this point. 2 days in and regretting my $40 purchase.
can’t do anything without premium. you can do anything without buying premium, can’t log food, workouts, fasting, anything.

Database search functionality is severely lacking. So far the app is decent, the AI food recognition is really good. However, the database search functionality is not good. If I search In N Out 3x3 protein Style for instance, my 1st 3 results are 1. Puerto Rican Style Tamales 2. Artichoke Salad in Oil 3. Carrots in Tomato Juice. No where on the List is In N Out.

Also, the app needs the ability to add fractional portions, for example if I scan a barcode for a snack, I need to be able to say I only ate half of it if that is the case.
